# CANDIDATE: VIX_DIP_BULLISH_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An intraday VIX contraction >0.5 points below its 20-period rolling mean signals reduced fear in the options market, allowing existing bullish momentum (price above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon: EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) to continue. The edge exists because VIX mean-reversion often precedes short-term bullish continuation when structural bullish alignment is present, and the no-recent-BOS-down condition prevents entering into false breakdowns.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At the close of a 5-minute bar when all conditions are true:  
- 5-minute VIX (or VIX1D proxy) < (20-period rolling mean of VIX - 0.5)  
- SPY close > VWAP (session VWAP)  
- EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 on the 5-minute chart (bullish ribbon)  
- No lower low since the VIX dip bar (no recent BOS down: track lowest low from the VIX dip bar to current bar; require no new lower low)  
Enter long at the close of that bar.  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: chart-stop at the most recent swing low (prior to entry)  
- TP1: 1.5R (risk-reward) from entry  
- Runner: trail stop at 15% off the high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 fills  
- Regime filters: only active when VIX between 15-30 and RTH 09:45-11:30; skip if ADX >25 (strong trending days)
